item.tib: gsang rgyud cha lag nyer mkho
item.coloph: ces pa'i gsang sngags ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho las/ sa steng gi skyes bu mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i rgyal ba gnyis pa mnyam med chen po'i gser khri la bzhengs pa'i skyes mchog rim byon gyi phyag mchod skal bzang dwangs 'dren dri med hi la bAdzar gyi phreng ba 'di yang / 'gru btsun shes rab tshul khrims kyi thugs bzhed du/ shel skyes g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dbang gi rgyal po'am/ brda' sprod snyan tshig gi ming thon kun mkhyen lung rig rgya mtsho tshangs sras dgyes pa'i blo ldan du 'bod pa des shar grol smin gling du/ legs sbyar saMskr-i ta yi skad duSha b+ha/ zhang zhung smar gyi skad du mtshon pa/ ma ha tsi na'i skad du zin zi/ stod 'brel bod kyi skad du khyu mchog dbang thang dang bstun pa'i ming ni lcags sbrul lo'i dga' ba dang po'i tshes la sbyar ba 'dis kyang mnyam med bla ma'i bstan pa srid rtser sbreng zhing snyan pa'i grags pa sa steng khyab pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
